Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Amar Jeet Upadhyay
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard Sri Abhshek, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Amar Jeet Upadhyay, learned counsel appearing for the informant and learned A.G.A. appearing for the State respondents.

2. The petitioner, by means of this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, has invoked the jurisdiction of this Court with prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 18.08.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 0487 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 328,
354, 376, 307 IPC, Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 3/4 Muslim Woman (Protection of Right on Mazahar Farukhi And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162760014/
1 Marriage) Act, 2019, Police Station Lisadigate, District- Meerut and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.
3.

entities.text: Muslim Woman (Protection of Right on Mazahar Farukhi And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The matter was referred before the Mediation Centre vide order dated 31.10.2023.
4. As per Mediation Centre report dated 2.12.2023 the amount of Rs. 30,000/- as directed by this Court has not been deposited.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that talks regarding compromise are going on between the parties outside the court, therefore, he may be permitted with withdraw present petition at this stage.

6. This prayer is being opposed by learned counsel appearing for the informant, who submits that no talks regarding compromise are taking place, however, in the interest of justice, he agrees that in case, the compromise takes place, the petitioners may be set at liberty to file fresh petition annexing copy of the compromise.
7. Accordingly, present petition stands dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.
